```python
def merge(left, right):
    result = []
    i,j = 0,0
    while i < len(left) and j < len(right): - left and right sublists
        if left[i] < right[j]:
            result.append(left[i])
            i += 1
        else:
            result.append(right[j])
            j += 1
    while (i < len(left)):
        result.append(left[i])
        i += 1
    while (j < len(right)):
        result.append(right[j])
        j += 1
    return result
```
